description: This file defines a React component named SSOModals used for managing Single Sign-On (SSO) settings. It handles loading existing SSO configurations, rendering form fields based on selected providers, submitting updates, and clearing settings. It also manages various modals for user interactions and instructions.

methods.name: useEffect
methods.description: Hook to load existing SSO settings when the modal opens.

methods.name: loadSSOSettings
methods.description: Async function to fetch current SSO settings and populate the form.

methods.name: handleFormSubmit
methods.description: Async function to handle form submission and save SSO settings.

methods.name: handleClearSSO
methods.description: Async function to clear existing SSO settings and reset the form.

methods.name: renderProviderFields
methods.description: Helper function to render input fields dynamically based on selected provider.
